claims.claim_text: The Republican Party stands for a hopeful future expected to follow total and complete victory in the War on Terror.
The described Republican values are characterized as worthy of a great nation and worth fighting for.
Vigilance in protecting the United States from counterterrorism dangers is never easy but is always essential, especially at the source time.
